scripts.dev:api: uv run --package memedrop-api uvicorn memedrop_api.main:app --app-dir apps/api/src --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3001 --reload
scripts.test:api:integration: uv run --package memedrop-api pytest -m integration apps/api/tests
scripts.lint:api: uv run --package memedrop-api ruff check apps/api
scripts.format:api: uv run --package memedrop-api ruff format apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=extension && uv run --package memedrop-api mypy apps/api/src apps/api/tests
scripts.test: node --test tests/*.test.mjs && npm run test --workspace=shared && npm run test --workspace=@memedrop/template-tools && npm run test:api && npm run test --workspace=extension
scripts.quality:static: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run lint:api && npm run build:extension && npm run manifest:audit --workspace=@memedrop/template-tools
scripts.quality:backend-image: docker build -f Dockerfile.backend -t memedrop-backend:local . && node scripts/smoke-backend-image.mjs
scripts.quality:promotion: npm run quality:static && npm run quality:api-process && npm run quality:benchmark && npm run quality:dataset-plan && npm run manifest:review-gate --workspace=@memedrop/template-tools && npm run manifest:coverage-gate --workspace=@memedrop/template-tools && npm run quality:release-metadata && npm run quality:store-readiness && npm run quality:release-config
scripts.dataset:qa-expansion: npm run dataset:expansion-report && npm run manifest:qa:expansion --workspace=@memedrop/template-tools
scripts.dataset:benchmark-stubs: npm run dataset:promotion-plan && npm run manifest:benchmark-stubs --workspace=@memedrop/template-tools -- --out .memedrop/suggestion-benchmark-stubs.json
scripts.quality:suggestions: uv run --package memedrop-api pytest apps/api/tests/test_catalog.py apps/api/tests/test_context_analyzer.py apps/api/tests/test_meme_text.py apps/api/tests/test_openrouter.py apps/api/tests/test_suggestion_engine.py -q
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --package memedrop-api alembic upgrade head
